text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync 1. We need a compact welcome/drip for the April launch cohort. Goal: get users to first successful call and identify high-intent accounts for SDRs.
Jon Rivera: Outline please. Do we have cohort definitions?
Maya Patel: Yep 1. Three cohorts in the sheet: product-explorer, integrator, enterprise-eval. Link: https://docs.google.com/sheet/example (tab 'launch-apr')
Liam Chen: Recommend product-explorer gets 3 emails over 7 days, CTA = quickstart playground. Keep copy light.
Sophia Lee: Integrator gets deeper content: integration checklist, SDK snippets, and a Quickstart webinar invite on day 4.
Oliver Grant: enterprise-eval -> high-touch. Immediate SDR alert on engagement threshold. Prefer webhook to SalesQueue-Intl with tags.
Maya Patel: Draft routing rules in the sheet bottom. Webhook format (brief):

```
POST /hooks/sdr
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "cohort": "{{cohort}}",
  "score": {{engagement_score}},
  "campaign": "launch_apr_newsletter"
}
```

Jon Rivera: Define engagement_score. Suggest: clicks >=2 OR reply OR demo-scheduler click.
Maya Patel: OK I'll set threshold = clicks >=2 OR reply_count >=1 OR scheduler_click = true. Add 14d suppression after conversion.
Liam Chen: Also add timezone send staggering and per-domain throttling for deliverability.
Sophia Lee: Subject line prototypes (short): "Welcome to Redwood — 5min setup", "Try Redwood in 3 steps", "Start building with Redwood"
Oliver Grant: I'll own SDR mappings and SFDC rules. Will create SalesQueue-Intl with tags: cohort, region, eng_score.
OpsBot: Campaign record created: id=cmp_apr_2026_11, staging_send=2026-04-01T16:00:00Z, production_send=2026-04-02T16:00:00Z
Jon Rivera: Owners: copy - Sophia (integrator + enterprise), Maya (product-explorer). Design headers - Oliver.
Sophia Lee: I'll post copy drafts by Tue EOD. Will include alt subject lines for A/B.
Maya Patel: I'll add the webhook spec, cadence table, and ESP test cells to the sheet by Monday.
Liam Chen: Add a 1-click rating on email 3 (1-5) to capture quick satisfaction signal. Map rating to engagement_score.
Oliver Grant: After drafts, I'll run a small deliverability preview to QA inbox and check link tracking.
Jon Rivera: Also add a simple holdout (5%) for baseline metrics. We need open/click/convert benchmarks.
Maya Patel: Adding holdout to sheet now. Will include metrics rows for open, click, conversion, and demo-scheduler.
Sophia Lee: Mockups + copy ETA Tue. If anyone wants to suggest subject swaps, say now.
Liam Chen: I'll verify ESP throttles and reporting hooks during staging. Will flag any domain concerns.
OpsBot: Reminder: staging_sendchecklist assigned to @Oliver Grant and @Liam Chen on 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z :bell:
